title: European Stroke Organisation (ESO) guidelines on mobile stroke units for prehospital stroke management
shortTitle: European Stroke Organisation (ESO) guidelines on mobile stroke units

recommendations.classNote: Scope summary quoted from the publication abstract; the full graded recommendations are in the linked source.
recommendations.text: The safety and efficacy of mobile stroke units (MSUs) in prehospital stroke management has recently been investigated in different clinical studies. MSUs are ambulances equipped with a CT scanner, point-of-care lab, telemedicine and are staffed with a stroke specialised medical team.
